name: 1-solstice-bay.jpg
caption: v4 cover — the sculpted red Solara GT with its glowing full-width LED tail bar owns the center lane of the wet-neon boulevard, twin-yellow highway lines and neon reflections running to the sun disc and art-deco skyline; Remy (sunglasses, jacket trim, sidearm) with crew Marisol and Dex on the lit sidewalk edge, live traffic and palms; LOW TIDE objective, Lena Vale dialogue, crew bark, radio chip, full HUD and minimap waypoint route.

name: 2-air-one-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star pursuit on the double-yellow wet-neon highway: AIR ONE's rotor-blur disc and searchlight cone hold the NOS-boosting Solara at 84 MPH, twin nitro flames locked to its exhaust tips, while three sculpted Interceptors with white doors, push-bars and red/blue strobe halos close in; skid marks, four lit stars, AIR ONE chatter, radio and escape waypoint on the minimap.

name: 3-undertow-docks.jpg
caption: UNDERTOW docks rescue at sunset: Remy, Marisol and Dex approach the tall golden gate beam under gantry-crane silhouettes and container stacks, the western harbor channel shimmering with sunset light before soft coastal ridges on the horizon; Crane's crew holds the gate, with mission objective, Marisol dialogue, Dex flank bark and SMG ready.

name: 4-strand-firefight.jpg
caption: BURN NOTICE firefight: Remy and Dex trade crossing tracers and muzzle flashes with three gang members behind a burning wreck and smoke column; teal sculpted getaway Solara with LED tail bar over wet-neon lane reflections, three-star wanted HUD, weapon/ammo chip and neon-lit pastel skyline.
